'''September 2001 Melbourne tournament (3 September)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Melbourne, Australia on 3 September 2001. [[Kevin Ch'ng]] won it. It is known from Haakon ".prototype." Geburtstag's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2914">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-02-melbourne-australia-3-9-2001d2914/ melbourne-australia-3-9-2001], DeckTech (Haakon ".prototype." Geburtstag, 2 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-02-melbourne-australia-3-9-2001d2914/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 3 September 2001
* '''Site:''' Melbourne, Australia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Kevin Ch'ng]]
